name: Keyboard-mode farmer (camera pip)
canvasNote: renderer/mock-source.js paintPreviewFrame() allocates a 400×300 canvas, paints a static peach oval once at start(), and captureStream(12) feeds <video id='preview' class='mirror-video'>. The oval never changes expression.
mirrorNote: The preview video uses CSS transform: scaleX(-1), like a selfie camera. Frames in this pack are painted as they should look on screen. SmileFarmer.paint() flips them when drawing onto the existing 400×300 capture canvas so hold [ still leans left after the CSS mirror. If you drop the CSS mirror for sprite mode, call paint(..., { preflip: false }).

rollDeg.source: renderer/mock-source.js emits SmileStretch.syntheticLandmarks(rollDeg); game/stretch.js tiltSide treats <= -15 as left, >= 15 as right.

priorityNote: Hide (F / no face) wins, then a neck tilt, then smile, then talk, then the optional breathe loop if the visit phase is a breath step, otherwise rest with an occasional blink. Harvest has no face state of its own.

blink.note: Play the strip once, then hold rest. Soft blink only.

talk.when: keys.talk or the talking flag from mock-source
talk.note: A small speech-leaf floats beside the mouth. Loop while talking, then return to rest.

tilt-left.screen: Head leans toward the left of the pip (the player's left in the mirrored preview), matching the stretch guide.
tilt-left.note: Eyes-closed relaxed stretch. Head and hat lean 20°; shoulders stay level.

tilt-right.screen: Head leans toward the right of the pip.
tilt-right.note: Eyes-closed relaxed stretch. Head and hat lean 20°; shoulders stay level.

hidden.note: Empty garden with the farmer's straw hat resting on a fence post. No figure-only variant; the whole frame is the art.

breathe.when: phase is breathe, care-harvest, care-hub-breathe, or camera-check-breath. Keyboard mode has no breathe key; fertilizer is guided.

harvest.note: No dedicated face state. Harvest is confirmed with Enter or Space. Keep rest, or smile if you want a pleased look.

backdrops.note: Full painted garden fills, for layering with the transparent figure-only PNGs in ui/farmer/figure/{day|night}/.

wiring.note: Today paintPreviewFrame() runs only once inside start(), so the stream is a still frame. Call SmileFarmer.paint(ctx, state) from tick() (or after each setKeys) and the 12 fps captureStream will pick up the new canvas. Do not rely on the .pip-mock-capture CSS oval; that path is only for screenshot capture when no stream is attached.
